title: Post-login migration confirmation modal
description: Instead of auto-migrating anonymous progress on signup verification, show a confirmation modal after login. This prevents accidental migration to wrong accounts and gives users control over their data.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Modal shows after successful login if localStorage has anonymous progress
Modal does NOT show if user's ID is in songscript_migration_declined_by array
Modal displays progress summary: 'Found X words and Y songs on this device'
Modal has 'Import to my account' button (accept)
Accept: calls migration mutation, clears localStorage progress on success
Decline: adds userId to songscript_migration_declined_by array in localStorage
Modal does not block app usage - can be dismissed
Remove auto-migration from verify.tsx (migration now happens via modal)
Verify in browser: modal appears after fresh login with localStorage progress

technicalNotes: Hook into auth state change or dashboard load to trigger modal
Use existing Dialog component from shadcn/ui
Store declined_by as JSON array in localStorage
Call migrateAnonymousData mutation from US-055 on accept
testingNotes: Test with fresh localStorage progress + new user login
Test that declined users don't see modal again
Test that different user on same device sees modal
completionNotes: Created src/components/MigrationConfirmModal.tsx with Dialog from shadcn/ui
Modal shows progress summary (words, lines, songs) from localStorage
Import button calls migrateAnonymousData mutation and clears localStorage on success
Decline button adds userId to songscript_migration_declined_by array
shouldShowMigrationModal() checks both hasProgressToMigrate() and hasDeclinedMigration()
Removed auto-migration from verify.tsx - migration now happens via dashboard modal
Removed 'Bring my progress' checkbox from signup.tsx (no longer needed)
Added MigrationConfirmModal to dashboard.tsx with trigger on session load
